preset.bittorrent.description: Route BitTorrent traffic. Direct by default, or send it to a separate channel.
preset.bittorrent.label: BitTorrent
preset.bittorrent.var.outbound.title: Outbound
preset.bittorrent.var.outbound.tooltip: Where to route BitTorrent. Direct to keep it off the VPN, or pick a channel to tunnel it.
preset.block-ads.description: Reject ad-related connections. Downloads rule set (~1 MB).
preset.block-ads.label: Block Ads
preset.fakeip.description: Instant DNS via placeholder IPs; real names resolve inside the tunnel. Speeds up DNS and prevents pre-tunnel DNS leaks. Not a DPI bypass. Enable below special domains so GeoIP direct routing still works.
preset.fakeip.label: FakeIP
preset.fakeip.var.dns_enable.title: DNS
preset.fakeip.var.dns_enable.tooltip: Apply this preset's FakeIP DNS handling. Turn off to disable FakeIP without removing the preset.
preset.fakeip.var.dns_server.title: FakeIP server
preset.fakeip.var.dns_server.tooltip: The FakeIP allocator. Internal — bound to the fakeip DNS server.
preset.fakeip.var.force.title: Block HTTPS records
preset.fakeip.var.force.tooltip: Reply empty to HTTPS/SVCB DNS records (RFC 9460) so apps fall back to plain A/AAAA. Keeps these queries from leaking to the fallback DNS.
preset.private-ip.description: Route private IP ranges (LAN). Direct by default, or send to a channel to reach routers/devices over a local VPN.
preset.private-ip.label: Private IPs
preset.private-ip.var.outbound.title: Outbound
preset.private-ip.var.outbound.tooltip: Where to route private/LAN IPs. Direct for local access, or a channel to reach a remote LAN over VPN.
preset.ru-direct.description: Route Russian TLDs (.ru/.su/IDN), service CDNs (Yandex/VK/Avito/2GIS/banks/etc) and Russian IP ranges directly.
preset.ru-direct.label: Russian domains & IPs
preset.ru-direct.var.dns_enable.title: DNS
preset.ru-direct.var.dns_enable.tooltip: Send matched domains to this preset's DNS server and apply DNS-level options like Force IPv4. Turn off to keep routing without DNS changes.
preset.ru-direct.var.dns_ip.title: UDP server IP
preset.ru-direct.var.dns_ip.tooltip: Applies to UDP only. DoH and DoT are pinned to 77.88.8.88 with SNI safe.dot.dns.yandex.net.
preset.ru-direct.var.dns_server.title: DNS server
preset.ru-direct.var.dns_server.tooltip: Recommended: Base/UDP — most stable. DoH/DoT may be filtered by ISPs.
preset.ru-direct.var.force_ipv4.title: Force IPv4
preset.ru-direct.var.force_ipv4.tooltip: Resolve Russian domains to IPv4 only. Prevents dead IPv6 connections on networks without working global IPv6. Works through this preset's DNS rule — keep the DNS toggle on. Turn off if your network has functional IPv6.
preset.ru-direct.var.geoip_enabled.title: GeoIP IP-range fallback
preset.ru-direct.var.geoip_enabled.toolt: Match Russian-AS IPs as well as domains — catches CDN/QUIC/ECH cases where domain detection fails. Auto-downloads geoip-ru.srs (~150 KB) on first use.
preset.ru-direct.var.outbound.title: Outbound
preset.ru-direct.var.outbound.tooltip: Where to route traffic for Russian domains and IPs
preset.ru-inside.description: Services available only inside Russia. Direct by default, or route via a channel to reach them from abroad.
preset.ru-inside.label: Russia-only services
preset.ru-inside.var.force_ipv4.title: Force IPv4
preset.ru-inside.var.force_ipv4.tooltip: Resolve these domains to IPv4 only. Prevents dead IPv6 connections on networks without working global IPv6. Turn off if your network has functional IPv6.
preset.ru-inside.var.outbound.title: Outbound
preset.ru-inside.var.outbound.tooltip: Where to route Russia-only services. Direct on a Russian network; pick a Russian channel to reach them from abroad.
preset.traffic-processing.description: Core packet handling: sniff the domain, hijack DNS into the tunnel, resolve destinations for routing. Applied first, before all other rules.
preset.traffic-processing.label: Traffic Processing
preset.traffic-processing.var.hijack_dns:
Route all DNS queries through the tunnel's DNS engine.
⚠️ WARNING: turning this off disables FakeIP and all DNS rules — apps query their own DNS directly, uncontrolled. Keep on unless you know exactly why.
preset.traffic-processing.var.sniff_enab:
Detect protocol and domain from packets for accurate routing.
⚠️ WARNING: turning this off stops protocol matching (e.g. BitTorrent, TLS, QUIC), and domain matching too unless FakeIP is on.
preset.traffic-processing.var.sniff_time: How long to wait for the domain to appear in the packet before giving up.
preset.unknown-traffic.description: Reject traffic in the tunnel not attributed to any installed app (background/foreign processes). Send it direct to bypass VPN instead.
preset.unknown-traffic.label: Unknown traffic
preset.unknown-traffic.var.outbound.tool: Reject = drop. Or pick Direct to send it outside the VPN.

var.auto_detect_interface.title: Auto-detect interface
var.auto_detect_interface.tooltip: Automatically detect the default network interface
var.dns_default_domain_resolver.title: Default domain resolver
var.dns_default_domain_resolver.tooltip: Used by routing engine to resolve hostnames internally (outbound endpoints, routing rules). Not the resolver apps use. Recommended: cloudflare_udp, google_udp, or google_doh. Avoid local_dns_resolver here — system DNS leaks these lookups to your ISP, bypassing the VPN.
var.dns_final.title: DNS final
var.dns_final.tooltip: Default fallback DNS server. Used when an app's DNS query doesn't match any DNS rule. For privacy, prefer encrypted: google_doh, cloudflare_dot. For speed: cloudflare_udp, google_udp. local_dns_resolver (system DNS) is safe here.
var.dns_strategy.title: Preferred IP version
var.ipv6_enabled.title: Enable IPv6
var.ipv6_enabled.tooltip: Add an IPv6 address to the tunnel. Off by default — turn on only if your network has working IPv6. Turning on sets resolution to prefer IPv4, turning off forces IPv4-only — you can change the strategy in DNS Settings.
var.log_level.title: Log level
var.proxy_auth.title: Require auth
var.proxy_auth.tooltip: Whether the local proxy requires username/password. Forced on for non-loopback listen.
var.proxy_listen.title: Listen address
var.proxy_listen.tooltip: IPv4 the local proxy binds to. Suggestions above; any valid IPv4 is allowed (e.g. a specific LAN IP). Anything other than 127.x is reachable from the network and forces auth on.
var.proxy_pass.title: Proxy password
var.proxy_pass.tooltip: Password for proxy auth. Auto-generated when auth turns on.
var.proxy_port.title: Listen port
var.proxy_type.option.mixed: Mixed — HTTP + SOCKS5 on one port
var.proxy_type.title: Local proxy protocol
var.proxy_type.tooltip: Inbound type for the local proxy port.
var.proxy_user.title: Proxy username
var.proxy_user.tooltip: Username for proxy auth (when auth is on).
var.resolve_enabled.title: Resolve destination IP
var.resolve_enabled.tooltip: Resolve the sniffed domain to an IP before routing, so GeoIP and IP rules can match. Turn off when using FakeIP — the fake IP already carries the domain, and a real lookup here would bypass FakeIP and can fail on a broken resolver.
var.resolve_strategy.title: Resolve strategy
var.resolve_strategy.tooltip: IP version preference for DNS resolution
var.route_address_enable.title: Custom tunnel routes
var.route_address_enable.tooltip: Route all IPv4 and IPv6 through the tunnel via explicit half-ranges instead of sing-box defaults. Off by default — turn on only if the default routing misbehaves.
var.tls_fragment.title: TLS Fragment
var.tls_fragment.tooltip: Split TLS ClientHello into small TCP segments
var.tls_fragment_fallback_delay.title: Fallback delay
var.tls_fragment_fallback_delay.tooltip: Wait time when automatic detection fails
var.tls_mixed_case_sni.title: Mixed-case SNI
var.tls_mixed_case_sni.tooltip: Randomize letter case in server_name (WwW.gOoGle.CoM). Bypasses simple exact-match DPI; ineffective against GFW-class filtering
var.tls_record_fragment.title: TLS Record Fragment
var.tls_record_fragment.tooltip: Split handshake into multiple TLS records (try this first)
var.tun_address.title: IPv4 address
var.tun_address6.title: IPv6 address
var.tun_address6.tooltip: TUN interface IPv6 address (CIDR). Applied only when Enable IPv6 is on.
var.tun_auto_route.title: Auto route
var.tun_mtu.title: MTU
var.tun_name.title: TUN interface
var.tun_stack.title: Stack
var.tun_strict_route.title: Strict route
var.tun_strict_route.tooltip: May break connectivity on some devices
var.urltest_interval.title: Test interval
var.urltest_interval.tooltip: How often sing-box re-tests and re-picks. Lower → faster switching, but more background traffic and battery: each cycle dials the servers (waking suspended tunnels). 15m is the battery-friendly default.
var.urltest_tolerance.title: Tolerance (ms)
var.urltest_tolerance.tooltip: Only switch proxy if latency difference exceeds this
var.urltest_url.title: Test URL
var.urltest_url.tooltip: Endpoint for measuring proxy latency. Pick a preset or type any URL — 204 / tiny-body endpoints are best.
var.vpn_mode.option.proxy: Proxy — local port only, no TUN
var.vpn_mode.title: VPN mode
var.vpn_mode.tooltip: How the core captures traffic. Set from VPN Settings → Mode.
